questions.q: Which of the following BEST describes the primary objective of an IS audit?
options: To detect and prevent all fraud within the organization
To provide assurance that IS controls are adequate and effective
To replace the role of management in overseeing IT
To ensure full compliance with all applicable regulations
questions.explanation: The primary objective of an IS audit is to provide assurance that information systems controls are adequate, effective, and aligned with organizational objectives. Fraud detection is a benefit, not the primary purpose.
questions.mindset: An auditor provides assurance — they evaluate whether controls exist and work. They do not implement or enforce.

questions.q: An IS auditor discovers a significant control weakness during an audit. What is the MOST appropriate first action?
options: Document the finding and discuss it with management
Ignore it if it falls outside the audit scope
questions.explanation: The auditor's role is to document findings and communicate them to management — not to fix problems themselves. Fixing issues would compromise auditor independence.
questions.mindset: Auditors report and recommend. They do not implement fixes. Independence is everything.
